name: Lagrangian Cloud Simulation with SPH
definition: A physics-based procedural model for real-time animation of cumulus clouds at landscape scale. It couples a coarse Lagrangian model of air parcels (thermals) with procedural amplification using volumetric noise. It uses particle-implicit environment interactions to avoid sampling the transparent sky, ensuring real-time efficiency.
summary: Lagrangian Cloud Simulation with SPH is a real-time procedural model that simulates large-scale cumulus clouds by coupling coarse Lagrangian air parcels with procedural noise, avoiding the high computational cost of Eulerian methods.
